verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs mention running 'production workloads in isolated containers' but this appears to refer to Vercel's own sandboxed execution/compute model rather than a documented workflow for deploying arbitrary user-supplied Dockerfiles/Docker images, which is Vercel's traditional Git-push/build-system deployment model per other docs and CLI evidence. Missing for 10: explicit Dockerfile/Docker image import support, documentation of a 'docker deploy' or container registry integration, and independent/hands-on confirmation that Docker-packaged apps can be deployed as-is.
